# AgentFi — Complete Product Documentation

> AgentFi makes any website AI-agent-ready. We auto-optimize your pages for machine reading and get your bots through firewalls legally — via Visa Trusted Agent Protocol and Cloudflare.

---

## The Problem

Your site is invisible to AI agents. Pages aren't structured for machine reading. Modern firewalls like Cloudflare aggressively block any unrecognized bot — even ones trying to read your site to index products or make a purchase. Unless it's Googlebot, useful AI agents are silently turned away. And getting into agentic commerce takes months of integration work across multiple open protocols.

---

## How AgentFi Works (Three Steps)

### Step 1: Point Us to Your Site
Enter your URL. AgentFi crawls and parses every page that needs AI optimization. No catalog uploads, no manual data prep.

### Step 2: We Create AI-Ready Versions
AgentFi auto-generates optimized versions of your pages — rewritten for AI comprehension, with structured markup and semantic tags. These are served on your domain via a transparent proxy as alternate versions for AI agents. Humans see the original pages. AI agents see the optimized versions.

### Step 3: Product Feeds Go to Agentic Commerce
If you have a product feed, upload it and we generate UCP-compatible commerce profiles. Your products become discoverable and transactable by any AI agent that speaks UCP or AP2. Agents can find and buy directly.

---

## Product 1: AI Site Optimizer

**Target:** Any business that wants its website readable and actionable for AI agents.

### Automatic Site Crawling
Enter your URL. AgentFi scans your pages and detects what needs optimization for AI agents. Zero manual work — the crawler handles everything.

### AI-Optimized Page Proxy
AgentFi generates alternate versions of your pages with structured data, semantic markup, and clean content. Served on your domain via transparent proxy — AI agents see the optimized version, humans see the original. Your domain, your brand.

### Product Feed Distribution
Connect your product feed and we generate UCP-compatible commerce profiles. Any AI agent that speaks UCP can discover, compare, and purchase your products natively — across any UCP-compatible surface, not just Google's.

---

## Product 2: Agent Trust & Access (KYA — Know Your Agent)

**Target:** Developers building products whose bots need to access third-party websites and execute transactions.

### The Problem
Your agents need data from third-party sites, but Cloudflare blocks them on sight. Traditional firewalls treat all unrecognized bots as threats — even when the bot is trying to do something useful like index information or complete a purchase.

### Agent Security Audit
Before issuing credentials, AgentFi performs a comprehensive security audit of your agent product — code behavior analysis, data access scope review, intent verification, and compliance checks. Only agents that pass our audit receive KYA certification.

### Digital Signatures for Your Bots
Once your product passes the audit, AgentFi issues cryptographic signatures that prove your agents are legitimate. Cloudflare and other WAFs recognize them automatically — no CAPTCHA, no blocks, no silent drops.

### Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
Your verified agents carry a TAP credential backed by Visa and recognized by major firewalls. Legitimate, compliant access to any site your product needs.

### Agent Payment Cards
Need your bots to make purchases? AgentFi issues purpose-bound virtual cards via AP2 mandates and Visa/Mastercard Agentic Pay. Each card is tied to a verified agent identity, a specific purchase intent, and a spending limit — full audit trail, full compliance.

### From Grey-Area Scraping to Compliant Access
Audited products get a trust certificate that turns scraping into authorized, transparent data access. No more legal grey areas.

## Market Coverage

AgentFi optimizes any page for AI agents — not just product catalogs.

### Services & Booking
AI-readable versions of service pages so agents can understand availability, pricing, and booking flows — then book and pay on behalf of users.
Examples: healthcare appointments, restaurant reservations, service scheduling.

### Digital Goods
Software licenses, event tickets, subscriptions — optimized so agents can parse terms, compare options, and complete purchases natively.
Examples: SaaS licenses, event tickets, streaming access.

### Physical Goods
Product pages, spec sheets, delivery info — converted into AI-native formats agents can read, compare, and act on. From complex retail to custom manufacturing.
Examples: custom products, B2B equipment, luxury items.

### B2B & Informational
Corporate catalogs, pricing pages, whitepapers — optimized so procurement agents and research bots can extract the right data and take the right action.
Examples: office supplies, industrial parts, wholesale orders.

---

## Open Standards & Protocols

AgentFi implements the following open agentic commerce standards:

### UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol)
An open-source standard for the full commerce journey: product discovery (via `/.well-known/ucp` profiles), cart, checkout, and order management. Transport-agnostic — works over REST, MCP, and A2A. AgentFi generates UCP-compatible profiles for merchants, making them discoverable by any UCP-speaking agent or platform. Partners include Shopify, Walmart, Target, Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, Adyen, and 20+ others.

### AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol)
An open-source standard for secure agent-initiated payments. Establishes Mandates — cryptographically-signed digital contracts — as verifiable proof of user intent. AgentFi implements AP2 mandates and verifiable credentials, enabling agents to carry signed proof of user intent and execute secure payments across any AP2-compatible merchant. 60+ industry partners including Adyen, PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Coinbase.

### Visa TAP (Trusted Agent Protocol)
AgentFi uses this standard to provide validation to third-party agents. Through AgentFi, verified bots automatically become Visa TAP compatible and are recognized by Cloudflare and other major firewalls.

### Mastercard Agentic Pay
AgentFi utilizes these rails to allow verified agents to issue purpose-bound virtual cards for specific transactions — with spending limits and full audit trails.
